name: Pictor
introduction: is the Painter’s Easel, introduced by Nicolas-Louis de Lacaille in the 1750s. It is a faint constellation near Canopus in the southern sky.

sections.title: What makes it special
paragraphs: [Beta Pictoris](hip:27321), 64 light-years away, is one of the most famous young stars. In 1984, it became the first star whose dusty disk was directly imaged, and two giant planets were later found orbiting within it, showing a planetary system in the making.

[Kapteyn’s Star](id:10pc-0059), about 13 light-years away, is an ancient red dwarf from the Milky Way’s halo. It orbits the galaxy in the opposite direction from the Sun and races past us at high speed.

sections.title: Notable stars
paragraphs: [Alpha Pictoris](hip:32607) is a white star about 100 light-years away and the brightest star.

sections.title: Beyond the stars
paragraphs: The pulsar [PSR J0437−4715](id:psr-j0437m4715) is the nearest and brightest millisecond pulsar, spinning about 174 times per second. Pictor A is a radio galaxy whose jet shoots across hundreds of thousands of light-years.
